Here are 10 open-source vector databases, from my own knowledge. I haven't checked them against live sources, so confirm licenses and details before relying on them. Licenses in particular have changed for some of these projects.

| # | Database | GitHub URL | License | Language |
|---|----------|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Milvus | https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus | Apache-2.0 | Go (with C++ core) |
| 2 | Qdrant | https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant | Apache-2.0 | Rust |
| 3 | Weaviate | https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate | BSD-3-Clause | Go |
| 4 | Chroma | https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma | Apache-2.0 | Rust (originally Python) |
| 5 | pgvector | https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector | PostgreSQL License | C |
| 6 | Faiss | https://github.com/facebookresearch/faiss | MIT | C++ (with Python bindings) |
| 7 | Vespa | https://github.com/vespa-engine/vespa | Apache-2.0 | Java and C++ |
| 8 | LanceDB | https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb | Apache-2.0 | Rust |
| 9 | Vald | https://github.com/vdaas/vald | Apache-2.0 | Go |
| 10 | Marqo | https://github.com/marqo-ai/marqo | Apache-2.0 | Python |

**Caveats:**
- **Faiss** is a similarity-search library rather than a full database. It is often grouped with vector databases, but it has no built-in server, persistence layer, or query API.
- **Chroma:** Its core was rewritten in Rust, but the Python client remains. I'm unsure of the current language split.
- **Licenses can change.** Several vector and search projects have changed licenses over the years, so check each repo's LICENSE file.

I can verify these against the live GitHub repos if you'd like. I can also swap in others, such as Redis (vector search), OpenSearch, or Elasticsearch, or add stars and last-commit dates.
